title: Addressing Rise in Suicide Cases and Making Mental Healthcare Assistance Readily Accessible
what_it_is: Addressing Rise in Suicide Cases and Making Mental Healthcare Assistance Readily Accessible

sections.label: Suicide rise and mental health
sections.summary: The Minister for Health was asked about steps to address a 25% rise in 2022 suicides and making mental health assistance more accessible and affordable.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair
sentences.text: asked the Minister for Health whether the Ministry is (i) taking any steps to address the 25% rise in suicide cases in 2022 and (ii) making mental health assistance more readily accessible and affordable to the public.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To address the issue of potential suicide, the best interventions include building mental resilience, encouraging help-seeking, spotting early indicators for crisis intervention and supporting individuals who are in crisis.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: At the national level, the Health Promotion Board (HPB)'s MindSG portal and the "It's OKAY to Reach Out" campaign promote self-help and provide guidance on maintaining good mental well-being, such as managing emotions and stress.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To enable children and youths to take active steps in building their mental wellness, mental resilience is taught in schools through the refreshed Character and Citizenship Education curriculum.

sections.label: Community Well-being Circles
sections.summary: Well-being Circles in the community strengthen peer support by equipping citizens with skills to care for their own and others' mental well-being.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Meanwhile, in the community, Well-being Circles have been set up to strengthen community and peer support by equipping citizens with the skills to care for their own mental well-being and that of others around them.

sections.label: Community mental health teams
sections.summary: Community mental health teams set up by social service agencies and supported by the Government provide mental health assessment and psychosocial intervention.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Community mental health teams supported by the Government and set up by social service agencies provide mental health assessment and psychosocial intervention for such clients.

sections.label: Free community mental health services
sections.summary: Many of the community services mentioned are provided at no cost.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Health (Dr Janil Puthucheary) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: Many of the above-mentioned services in the community are provided at no cost.

sections.label: Counsellors, psychologists and unassisted cases
sections.summary: Access to regular counsellors or psychologists may help manage surfaced cases, and many had not sought assistance before the tragic events.

sentences.speaker: Mr Vikram Nair (Sembawang)
sentences.text: It may be that access to regular counsellors or psychologists would be helpful to manage cases that are surfaced.

sentences.speaker: Dr Janil Puthucheary
sentences.text: There are a significant number who had not sought assistance before the tragic events.
